node.statement: By nonnegativity of the norm and the root hypothesis ||w(I_{C^m})-I_A||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon, together with W.c0_cb=c0, we have 0<=c0*epsilon. Since W.L>=L^0>=1, multiplication of 1<=W.L by the nonnegative number c0*epsilon yields c0*epsilon<=W.L*(c0*epsilon)=c0*W.L*epsilon.
